name: scroll_volume_ratio_cycle_r134a
title: Scroll refrigeration cycle (R134a): built-in volume ratio vs isentropic efficiency and COP
summary: Discussion model of a scroll compressor driving a R134a refrigeration machine: the built-in volume ratio of the machine is the input, the compression is isentropic down to the built-in volume and isochoric up to the discharge pressure; the model returns the pressure ratio the machine develops, its isentropic efficiency and the COP of the cycle.

origin.course: Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), repetition session 2, exercise 3 (header VL050926, 2005-09-26)

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solutions: 3 of the 5 non-cleared variables of TM-0042 agree within 5.8e-4, and at its operating point 17 of the 30 variables stored in duplicate-group copy TM-0043 agree within 9.1e-4 (COP 6.7e-4); 11 are excluded (reference-state offset, EES/CoolProp vapour density). Cycle energy balance closed to 1.7e-13.
verification.reference: Solution stored in the source file TM-0042 (5 non-cleared variables) and in the duplicate-group copy TM-0043 (VL050926_2-3-1.EES, EES X7.403, 30 variables, T_ev = 0 °C, T_cd = 30 °C, r_v_in = 5), re-run at that operating point
verification.notes: TM-0042: compare_solution.py prints "5 common variables, 2 differ (rtol=0.001)"; T_cd and r_v_in identical, P_cd 5.8e-4 (EES X7.458 vs CoolProp saturation pressure), h_ex_cd/h_su_ev excluded (constant 148 139 J/kg reference-state offset, EES h = 0 for saturated liquid at -40 °C). TM-0043: "30 common variables, 11 differ (rtol=0.001)"; the 17 others agree within 9.1e-4 (worst P_in, r_p_in), COP 6.7e-4, epsilon_s 4.0e-4; excluded: 8 absolute enthalpies and s_su_cp (offset +148114...148169 J/kg and +795.50 J/kg.K, 3.8e-4 after removing the mean offset), v_su_cp and v_in (1.06e-3, saturated-vapour specific volume at 0 °C: 0.0693087 m^3/kg in CoolProp, 0.0693824 in EES X7.403), T_ev and T_su_cp (both zero). No unit conversion (SI-C-Pa-J). At the default point r_p_in = 5.404 > r_p = 4.698, so the isochoric step is a decompression (w_in_v = -2.79 kJ/kg).
